description_for_human: Create custom QR code merchandise - shirts, hats, mugs, bags with scannable QR codes linking to your content.
description_for_model: QR Gear is a print-on-demand merchandise platform that creates custom products (t-shirts, hats, mugs, tote bags) featuring QR codes. The QR codes can link to text, URLs, hosted images, or dynamic content that can be updated over time. All products are made in the USA. The platform offers four product tiers: (1) Simple Text QR with offline text/URL, (2) Pre-designed templates with curated backgrounds, (3) Fully custom designs with user uploads, and (4) Dynamic QR with subscription hosting that allows content updates. Ideal for business promotion, faith-based gifts, memorial products, and event merchandise. Pricing starts at $18 for base products with optional upcharges for text labels and extended hosting.
